name: heldout_commercial_v1
description: Synthetic Lumen ARC-12 service documents authored for this checkpoint. The domain, identifiers, values, and questions are independent of the existing RALG benchmark suites.

documents.name: lumen_arc12_startup
documents.text: LUMEN ARC-12 VACUUM KILN STARTUP CARD. Set chamber purge pressure to 3.7 bar. Use only Vireo-22 coolant. Before opening the service hatch, isolate disconnect K-41 and verify zero voltage at terminal J3.

documents.name: lumen_arc12_alarms
documents.text: LUMEN ARC-12 ALARM GUIDE. For an amber FEED-LOW alarm, inspect screen F-9 and verify valve V-12 is fully open. For a crimson TEMP-HIGH alarm, stop the cycle, keep circulation running, and notify the shift lead.

documents.name: lumen_arc12_restart
documents.text: LUMEN ARC-12 RESTART CARD. After service, close the hatch, remove all tools, hold RESET for four seconds, run the kiln idle for 75 seconds, and record outlet temperature in the service log.
